description: Hebrew. Strip niqqud and cantillation, normalise the five final forms, map geresh and gershayim to ASCII. Postgres has no Hebrew configuration, so `simple` stands and this list is the only filtering there is.

pipeline._comment: Function words, folded by the four rules above so they can actually match. Postgres ships no stopword file for this language — the config either has none (arabic_stem) or does not exist — and websearch_to_tsquery joins its terms with AND, so every one of these would otherwise be a word the document is REQUIRED to contain. stemPrefixLength stays 0 on purpose: this script builds words from a root by infixing rather than only suffixing, and it attaches single-letter proclitics, so a fixed-length prefix groups unrelated words instead of relating inflections. Set one only with a corpus and a golden set to measure it against.
